parameters.name: BindId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the bound service.

sub_parameters.name: BindPort
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to bind the port. Valid values:

- **true**: Yes.
- **false**: No.

sub_parameters.name: EndPort
sub_parameters.description: The end port that the probe listens on.

sub_parameters.name: Fixed
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether the port is fixed. Valid values:

- **0**: No.
- **1**: Yes.

sub_parameters.name: Id
sub_parameters.description: The unique identifier of the bound port.

sub_parameters.name: StartPort
sub_parameters.description: The start port that the probe listens on.

parameters.name: BindType
parameters.description:
The service binding type. Valid values:

- **forward_honey**: forward to honeypot
- **scan_port**: listen for scans.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Minimum value: **1**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: HoneypotId
parameters.description:
The honeypot ID.
> You can call the [ListHoneypot](~~ListHoneypot~~) operation to obtain this value.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page when using paged query. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned per page by paging.
> Do not leave PageSize empty.

parameters.name: ProbeId
parameters.description:
The probe ID.
>You can call the [ListHoneypotProbe](~~ListHoneypotProbe~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: ServiceIpList
parameters.description: The list of listening IP addresses.
